description: Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha - Declare that Mr. H. M. L. Priyadarshana of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of that Pradeshiya  Sabha as he has been ceased to be a member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a notice made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically concerns the status of an elected member of a local government body, falling squarely within electoral processes and related matters.
